title: Fridge Inventory App
soWhat: A cloud-hosted fridge inventory app whose stock records and running-low alerts make the food in the fridge go further and reduce how often fridge and pantry items are bought, forgotten, and left to expire.
problem: A paper list and memory make it awkward for a family to share what is actually in the fridge, and without knowing how much is left at home, shopping tends to repeat purchases or leave items to expire.
role: Designed a cloud-hosted fridge inventory app around actual needs, using a Next.js front end with FastAPI and PostgreSQL for storage. Stock can be adjusted with a simple + / - control, and besides entering items by hand it supports OCR of shopping receipts to import stock automatically, cutting down the friction of keeping records.
method: Groups items into categories — vegetables, meat, dry goods, canned food, and so on — to cut search effort
Writes every change to an event log
Lets you set running-low alerts to refer to when shopping

figures.caption: Inventory list grouped by category (fish / meat / vegetables / dry goods), with quantity adjustment, editing, and deletion inline.
Adding food: manual entry or scanning a receipt, with three tracking modes — exact count, estimated remaining, or simply in stock.
